usage: fleet-switchboard agents verify [-h] [--strict]
                                       [--installed-dir INSTALLED_DIR]
                                       [--opencode OPENCODE]
                                       [--timeout TIMEOUT]

Reads `opencode api GET /api/agent` and fails (exit 1) when an agent of the
kit is missing, has the wrong mode or lacks a rule its definition declares. A
service that is not running is reported, not failed. Run it after installing
the agents and restarting the service.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --strict              Exit 1 when the service cannot be asked (default: say
                        so and exit 0)
  --installed-dir INSTALLED_DIR
                        The folder of installed agent files to compare bodies
                        with (default: the private profile's agents folder)
  --opencode OPENCODE   The opencode executable (default: opencode on PATH)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Seconds to wait for the service (default 20)
